rotate-flip-photo.formula:
After r quarter-turns clockwise:
outputW = (r odd) ? height : width
outputH = (r odd) ? width : height
Example: 800 x 600 px, one 90° clockwise turn -> 600 x 800 px.
Flip horizontal: pixel (x, y) -> (width - 1 - x, y).
howTo: Upload a photo from your device (up to 15 MB).
Tap Rotate 90° (either direction) or 180° to fix the orientation.
Use Flip horizontal or vertical to mirror the image.
Combine transforms freely — the preview updates instantly.
Press Download to save the transformed image as a PNG.

limitations: Only 90° steps and flips — arbitrary angles are not supported (they would need resampling).
Rendering is capped at 1600 px on the long edge, so huge originals are scaled down first.
EXIF metadata (camera info, GPS) is stripped from the re-encoded download.
Animated images use their first frame only.
